answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can deploy linkable ring signatures: each identity is vouched into a ring by peers, and the signature stays linkable. When one clone on a ridge of fakes is exposed, the linkage betrays the whole plume of co-conspirators, and their bonded marble deposits are forfeited together. A farmer running a thousand sybils thus risks losing every stake the moment any single one is caught, so cloning no longer pays.
